SELECT 
    t.transportregistry AS transport_registry_id,
    (
        (t.vehiclecount * 0.2) +
        (t.trucksavailable * 0.2) +
        (t.helosavailable * 0.15) +
        (t.boatsavailable * 0.15) +
        (t.totaldeliverytons * 0.1) +
        (t.dailydeliverytons * 0.1) +
        CASE 
            WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'On Track' THEN 10
            WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'Delayed' THEN 5
            ELSE 0
        END +
        (t.distributionpoints * 0.05) +
        (100 / (1 + t.avgdeliveryhours)) * 0.05 +
        (t.deliverysuccessrate * 0.05) +
        CASE 
            WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'Optimized' THEN 5
            WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'In Progress' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END +
        (t.fuelefficiencylpk * 0.03) +
        CASE 
            WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Up to Date' THEN 5
            WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Due' THEN 2
            ELSE 0
        END -
        (t.vehiclebreakrate * 0.02)
    ) AS lpm_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN (
            (t.vehiclecount * 0.2) +
            (t.trucksavailable * 0.2) +
            (t.helosavailable * 0.15) +
            (t.boatsavailable * 0.15) +
            (t.totaldeliverytons * 0.1) +
            (t.dailydeliverytons * 0.1) +
            CASE 
                WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'On Track' THEN 10

                ELSE 0
            END +
            (t.distributionpoints * 0.05) +
            (100 / (1 + t.avgdeliveryhours)) * 0.05 +
            (t.deliverysuccessrate * 0.05) +
            CASE 
                WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'Optimized' THEN 5
                WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'In Progress' THEN 3

            END +
            (t.fuelefficiencylpk * 0.03) +
            CASE 
                WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Up to Date' THEN 5
                WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Due' THEN 2
                ELSE 0
            END -
            (t.vehiclebreakrate * 0.02)
        ) < 50 THEN 'Logistics Breakdown'
        ELSE 'Normal Operation'
    END AS status
FROM 
    transportation AS t;

Task ID: disaster_6

User Query:
Compute the Logistics Performance Metric for all transportation operations. For each transport registry ID, display the corresponding LPM score and determine its status: label as 'Logistics Breakdown' if a Logistics Failure is detected, otherwise label as 'Normal Operation'. Present the results.

You have a budget of 16.0 bird-coins. Use your tools to explore the database, clarify ambiguities with the user, and submit your final SQL efficiently.

events.sql:
SELECT 
    t.transportregistry AS transport_registry_id,
    (
        (t.vehiclecount * 0.2) +
        (t.trucksavailable * 0.2) +
        (t.helosavailable * 0.15) +
        (t.boatsavailable * 0.15) +
        (t.totaldeliverytons * 0.1) +
        (t.dailydeliverytons * 0.1) +
        CASE 
            WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'On Track' THEN 10
            WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'Delayed' THEN 5
            ELSE 0
        END +
        (t.distributionpoints * 0.05) +
        (100 / (1 + t.avgdeliveryhours)) * 0.05 +
        (t.deliverysuccessrate * 0.05) +
        CASE 
            WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'Optimized' THEN 5
            WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'In Progress' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END +
        (t.fuelefficiencylpk * 0.03) +
        CASE 
            WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Up to Date' THEN 5
            WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Due' THEN 2
            ELSE 0
        END -
        (t.vehiclebreakrate * 0.02)
    ) AS lpm_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN (
            (t.vehiclecount * 0.2) +
            (t.trucksavailable * 0.2) +
            (t.helosavailable * 0.15) +
            (t.boatsavailable * 0.15) +
            (t.totaldeliverytons * 0.1) +
            (t.dailydeliverytons * 0.1) +
            CASE 
                WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'On Track' THEN 10
                WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'Delayed' THEN 5
                ELSE 0
            END +
            (t.distributionpoints * 0.05) +
            (100 / (1 + t.avgdeliveryhours)) * 0.05 +
            (t.deliverysuccessrate * 0.05) +
            CASE 
                WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'Optimized' THEN 5
                WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'In Progress' THEN 3
                ELSE 0
            END +
            (t.fuelefficiencylpk * 0.03) +
            CASE 
                WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Up to Date' THEN 5
                WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Due' THEN 2
                ELSE 0
            END -
            (t.vehiclebreakrate * 0.02)
        ) < 50 THEN 'Logistics Breakdown'
        ELSE 'Normal Operation'
    END AS status
FROM 
    transportation AS t;
